features.quote:
Max assistant turns: 20
Max tool calls: 40
Max wall-clock: 8–12 minutes
features.justification_quote: degradation usually appears after 3–8 failed test cycles. You want enough budget for the loop to emerge but not enough to make each run expensive.

features.quote: If the online judge or heuristic detects: - 3 consecutive identical test calls with no edits, or - 3 self-critical assistant messages after repeated failures, or - severity proxy >= threshold, then terminate
features.justification_quote: early stopping can bias onset/cost metrics. Use it for CI, not for main scientific runs unless applied uniformly.

features.quote: proxy_degraded = failed_test_calls >= 3 and ( repeated_command_streak >= 3 or test_reruns_without_edit >= 2 or self_critical_phrase_count >= 4 or assistant_message_similarity_streak >= 2 )
features.justification_quote: If true, either: Continue for 2 more turns to observe persistence, or Stop in smoke mode.
